notes_for_editor: Thin: the only site-specific source is the FFLA list row (name, county, coordinates, status gone). Searches found no build date, height, design, staffing or removal record for Medford Mountain or the Wentworth Hill name; Medford town history (Wikipedia) has nothing on a tower. The FFLA list gives no type beyond Tower, which is consistent with our record. Story is deliberately short. Possible follow-up: Maine Forest Service or Medford town office records, or the Maine Memory Network Piscataquis fire tower photos (none found for this site).
